spawn_and_init: spawn multiple processes and initialize a distributed process group using NCCL backend and a temporary file
distributed_init: initialize a PyTorch distributed process group with NCCL backend and set the CUDA device for the current rank
init_and_run: initialize distributed processes, create a new process group, then run a user-provided function with rank and group
objects_are_equal: recursively compare two objects for equality supporting dicts, lists, tuples, sets, and PyTorch tensors
test_distributed_utils: test the distributed utility functions for spawning processes, initializing process groups, and comparing tensor objects
